title: Weekend Store Associate
summary: Help a busy clothing boutique on weekends: greet customers, keep the floor tidy, and run the register.
responsibilities: Welcome customers and help them find sizes and styles
Restock and fold merchandise, keep displays neat
Process sales and returns at the register
requirements: Comfortable on your feet for a full shift

title: Bilingual Chat Support Agent (Spanish/English)
summary: Answer customer questions over chat and email for an online retailer, in Spanish and English.
responsibilities: Reply to chat and email tickets within agreed response times
Resolve order, shipping and return questions
Log issues clearly so the team can follow up
requirements: At least one year in customer service
Reliable internet and a quiet place to work
